Episode 184. Beyond Destiny (14)
As Jin stepped into the veil of fire, the Eternal Flame that had been squeezing our allies ceased to move.
The huge storm that had been enveloping the entire fleet was as if time had stopped, completely stationary.
Our allies looked back and forth between the solid fire barrier and Jin, their eyes wide open.
In this era, blue fire symbolizes Jin Runecandle.
So, our allies had been thinking that something must have happened to Jin since the Eternal Flame had been attacking them.
They had no choice but to think that Jin had already been defeated somewhere in this castle's basement, absorbed by the monster, or turned into the monster's puppet attacking them.
Since the storm of the Eternal Flame was not heading towards the monster but strangling our allies, it was only natural.
But thoughts and feelings are different.
The temporary alliance believed, disregarding the situation.
Even if there was a problem with Jin, they said, he would ultimately be the one to resolve this situation.
That belief was now becoming a reality.
"Twelfth generation...!"
"The twelfth generation has arrived!"
Even those who had fallen in exhaustion squeezed out their remaining strength and screamed.
Hedo and Bianca had been moving the injured who had been fighting near Jin all along.
Among them, Octavia showed signs of regeneration even before the healers could get to her, receiving the energy of the mana stone.
[Father!?]
And Tasha, who had been pushing the Eternal Flame from the surface, ran to Alphen, screaming unknowingly.
[Tasha… You didn't succumb to the monster either. Recover a little, and I'll go back to fight, so keep your position.]
[Yes, Father!]
The former leader of Oktabi was taken care of by the medical staff of the Holy Kingdom.
Jin moved forward, switching his sword. The pale blade of the Bongnoe Sword, Siegmund, flickered blue in the darkness.
The Eternal Flame had completely stopped its progress, but the souls mixed within were heading towards one place like a swarm of insects.
On the opposite side of Jin, where the monster was. It seemed like the dark and massive form of the monster, obscured by the Eternal Flame and souls, could be seen.
"Jin."
Valeria approached Jin's side. She took out a red sphere, which looked like a ruby, from her possession and handed it to Jin.
"I've finished checking while we were separated. The monster's castle is a kind of subspace, so there were concerns, but fortunately, it works properly even here."
Jin nodded his head as he received the sphere.

"However, I haven't finished checking the stability issue. We can only hope that the spatial characteristics of this place do not cause any side effects. So, if there seems to be a problem during use, find me immediately."
Jin nodded his head.
"You've worked hard, Valeria. Our allies probably survived the Eternal Flame thanks to your role."
Just as Jin said, the biggest reason why the allies who had been separated from Jin did not suffer major damage from the Eternal Flame was due to Valeria.

They also experienced sudden falls and space transitions multiple times, just like Jin's group. Without Valeria's record magic during the process, the damage they would have suffered would have been incomparable to now.
Valeria's face was pale. She had cast her record magic, even at the risk of having the magic mechanism in the Eddy destroyed to form a temporary alliance. Fortunately, she avoided permanent damage.
If it were the old Valeria, before she met Jin.
She would never have risked her own safety to form a temporary alliance. Especially if Zephyr was included in that alliance.
But now, she also had comrades.
There were people she wanted to protect, even at the cost of her life, people who gradually enriched her life, which was just about the duties as a Hyster and revenge.
"Thank you."
Jin said, reading her inner thoughts. Valeria didn't mind that he understood her feelings.
"Don't get hurt."
"You too."
Our allies were regrouping. Only about 60% of the original fleet was left, but the remaining flagship including Cojack and Grunil were all in good condition.
"I will open the path, prepare for battle!"
As Jin's resounding voice echoed, the paused Eternal Flames began to whirl again.
But this time, instead of strangling our allies, it was heading towards the monster obscured by souls.
No one gathered here had ever seen such a huge fire moving at the will of a single person.
Even those who have directly experienced the power of Kelliac.
'Can he really control all that fire?'
'Maybe even the monster may not be able to handle all this fire. Considering the properties of the Eternal Flame that the twelfth generation possesses, it's impossible...!'
The onlookers couldn't hide their astonishment.
Originally, Jin could not fully control an Eternal Flame of this size. It was impossible to create an Eternal Flame that could engulf a fleet in the first place.
Because it had grown abnormally large due to his hatred for the monster and his soul energy.
But just as the monster used Jin's hatred to forcibly proliferate the Eternal Flame.
Now, Jin's will to protect his comrades, his desire to survive and fight with them till the end, was moving the Eternal Flame.
From the black curtain, souls exploded like an active volcano, but the flames of the Eternal Flame were fiercer.
The souls and the Eternal Flame collided and continuously caused explosions.
Eventually, the souls began to be pushed back.
A hole was made. As the Eternal Flame fiercely began to enter the gap, the curtain was quickly torn apart.
Aaahhh...!
A shockwave spread along with a loud noise, clearly the scream of the monster.
It was a powerful shockwave that even pushed back the Eternal Flame enveloping the curtain.
Jin momentarily flinched and stopped walking.
Behind him, the shields of his allies burst and debris flew.
More than 80% of the protective shield covering the entire fleet was shattered. From just one scream of the monster writhing in pain.
The allies, feeling a chill down their spine from this fact, deployed the shields again.
Each time the monster screamed, the shields shattered.
In an instant, the energy sources of most of the ships became so hot they seemed like they would explode, and the wizards attached to the energy sources fainted relentlessly.

They had to continuously replace them without even being able to care for those who had fallen. If the energy was drained from the energy source even for a moment, it would cause critical damage inside the ship.
The dragons and knights on the ground were in a similar situation. It meant that the monster had the power to kill them all just by screaming.
On the other hand, it also meant that the Eternal Flame was definitely inflicting damage on the monster.

Therefore, the allies desperately hoped. They hoped that the Eternal Flame would finish off the monster like this, that this dreadful fight would end like this, that after enduring this pain, they would see the monster burning without form beyond the torn curtain.
But the monster would not end like this.
Jin, convinced that he must thrust a blade into the monster's neck to end the fight, moved forward, resisting the shockwave.
After about ten seconds, the curtain of souls was completely torn. The curtain split like a door opening and the Eternal Flame surged in like a tidal wave.
Finally, Jin was able to face the hidden monster.
'This... is the monster?'
The monster had a completely different appearance from Jin's memory.
Not the appearance from when it was human, not the demon-like figure after being tainted by chaos, but a ghost-like appearance.
The monster was floating in the air. It had a humanoid figure, but the lower body was filled with black smoke made of souls instead of legs.
Hundreds of arms held all kinds of swords that exist in this world, and where the eyes should be, there was just an empty hole.
"That... Gliac!?"
"Isn't that the king of the Black Sea...?!"
The allies were startled.
As they expressed, the monster resembled 'Gliac,' the king of the Black Sea who had awakened at the time of the Sword Emperor's Temple.
Their faces turned pale, recalling the nightmare of that day.
It seemed like the monster, who almost destroyed the whole world, had reappeared as the 'monster.'
The monster was enduring the Eternal Flame that enveloped its entire body. Even though its whole body was burning, the monster was no longer screaming.
[You're curious.]
The monster's empty eye sockets met Jin's eyes.
[Whether the fire you have will never go out, or if it cannot be blocked by anything.]
Jin's eyes widened.
That was because the Eternal Flame enveloping the monster was slowly going out.
[Unfortunately, it seems not. It's really a wonderful sword, but it's not enough to kill this mother.]
Jin glared at the monster.
[But I'll praise you. You killed the spirits of the family, watched the disappearance of my last humanity, burned everything, even my name as a knight... and finally came to me.]
"It wasn't just the spirits. There were three ancestors whom you could not subdue. Moreover, there will be more such ancestors. Still don't get it? Monster, your power is not absolute."
Fzzzzz…!
Lightning was gathering in Jin's heart.
Rosa licked her lips feeling that power.
Due to the bizarre shape of her mouth, no one could recognize her smile.
[Youngest, you will die here now... It's your turn to become the myth of the family, the black land that I will rule in the future.]
"It's not me who's going to die, it's you. And you will be remembered as a nightmare of the world."
Send him to where young Rosa Runkandel is waiting.
As Jin said that, he crushed the red sphere he had held in his fist.
Then, all of a sudden, the lightning gathering in the heart began to tremble as if it would explode.
From the moment the bead broke, Jin could feel the sensation of an entity that had reached the ultimate point of the martial.
He could become that being.
The G.o.d-fighting member of the Ming Royal family, Ban. As G.o.d Fighting Unification unfolded, Jin and her inner world were connected.
(...Jin brother? What's happening? Suddenly, I'm getting brother's thoughts. G.o.d Fighting Unification is taking place. Is this the same coincidence as last time?)

'It's not a coincidence, God-fighting brother. I'm sorry for borrowing your power without notice. But I thought I would be connected with Ring-Ring first, luckily you were connected first, God-fighting brother.'
Ban read Jin's inner world in an instant, understood the situation, and replied like this.
(Huhu, I've been looking forward to this day. Jin brother. Let's fight together.)
